notes.title: FLASH OF THE BLADE X v.1.16
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We've received some fantastic coverage over the last few weeks! Thanks to all the creators that have spotlighted our game, and left reviews! Reviews help us massively in terms of getting seen, so please leave one if you haven't done so 😊

Anyway, you're here for patch notes -- so what have we done?

[list]
[*] Removed the majority of the cutscenes to streamline the action!
[*] Set the first cutscene so that it does not re-play upon death!
[*] Changed the player's crossbow to hitscan, so the projectile doesn't pass through enemies!
[/list]

and perhaps most exciting of all....

[list]
[*] Added a SUPER SECRET THROWBACK LEVEL! I hope you hate it. It also has dev commentary. Find it if you dare.
[/list]

We've still got some stuff in the bag that we will look to release for the game soon, but for now, please enjoy the update!

notes.title: FOTBX v1.15
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

Quality of Life fix patch

-- Auto-Saves at beginning of every level (into Slot 1)
-- Shuriken/Crossbow reloading removed.
-- Some minor map re-designs to allow for more HP placements/less being pushed back into the start room.
-- A NEW SUPER SECRET WEAPON WHICH ACTS AS A VERY EARLY PREVIEW OF A FUTURE DOSMAN TITLE.
-- One other small easter egg added.
-- Final boss reworked to be WAY more deadly. His stomps now have range, so prepare to get demolished!

notes.title: MASSIVE OVERHAUL | FLASH OF THE BLADE X
notes.notes:
[h1]ENTER THE NINJA[/h1]

Together with DOSMan Games' artist, Fred Richi - we have performed a MASSIVE OVERHAUL of the game. This includes the removal of the one-hit-kill mechanic, re-balance of enemies, levels, and weapons, new music (with a menu theme courtesy of DOSMan Games' BrazenScull!), a brand new fleshed-out story, and should bring the title in line with the future plans of DOSMan Games.

We hope you have fun with what we've done, please leave a review, and gift it to your friends! We will be raising the price to $2.99/€2.99/£2.49 after the current discount.

[h1]WHAT ARE THOSE FUTURE PLANS?[/h1]

Those plans are to make DOSMan Games the go-to for [u]bite-sized boomer shooters[/u]. We want to create short games, at low prices, with short development cycles. We have so many ideas for games and don't want to spend years making them! We want to give you games you can beat in an afternoon, or in the little slots of time you have when the kids are asleep. 

We've got plenty of titles on the horizon to keep you satiated too!
Head on over to our Steam page for more info! 

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45013750-DOSMan-Games/

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes:
I have updated the build with a few much needed fixes and changes, outlined below:

Removed PSX Shader Effect.
Raised Scale of Enemies/Textures so they appear sooner in the player view.
Migrated to v1.6 of Easy FPS Editor
Fixed the Enemy Duplication glitch on save/load
Fixed Audio Settings crash bug.
Changed Bow enemies to projectile instead of hitscan.
Made the final boss more challenging.
